name: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics — Population and Housing Census 2022: District Reports, Community Reports (Table C-01) and Union Statistics, Sylhet Division
organization: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS), Statistics and Informatics Division, Ministry of Planning
attribution: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics, Population and Housing Census 2022
notes: Population/households are final ENUMERATED counts (census moment 00:00 15 June 2022, incl. floating population), not PEC-adjusted. Unit lists and population per district/upazila/city corporation/thana/paurashava/union/ward from the Community Report Excel files, sheet C-01 (BBS 2022 geocodes; code_scheme BBS_GEOCODE_2022 = C-01 code columns joined with '-', prefixed by division 60). City-corporation units carry the city-corporation code in the geocode, so the 27 wards and 327 mahallas of Sylhet City Corporation (60-91-50, six metro thanas: Airport, Dakkhin Surma, Jalalabad, Kotwali, Moglabazar, Shahparan) are kept apart from paurashava wards and from the Sylhet Sadar (60-91-62) and Dakkhin Surma (60-91-31) upazilas. Administrative-unit counts, area and density from the District Report Key Findings tables (District Series, May-June 2024) and Union Statistics (June 2025) Table D01. basis: enumerated | as stated (printed in a BBS table) | derived (counted from the C-01 geocode rows). One non-union unit is printed in the Union/Ward column: 'Cantonment Union' (60-91-62-998, Sylhet Sadar upazila), kept at level cantonment, not counted as a union. Tea estates ('... Te', '... Tea Garden', '... Tea Estate'), reserve forests and haors appear only as mauzas inside unions, never in the Union/Ward column. Community Report labels on the BBS page: SYLHET, HABIGANJ, MAULVIBAZAR (output name Moulvibazar), SUNAMGANJ. Large PDFs/Excel are not committed; fetch.py --division sylhet re-downloads them (bbs.gov.bd needs the Sectigo DV R36 intermediate, added at runtime from its AIA URL).
